findings.text: non-blocking: _is_fragment_record duplicates the fragment-document predicate owned at reckon/crew/reports.py:2706 _fragment_plan_of (with reckon/resources.py:246 _is_evidence_fragment holding the subtree test), and is laxer - len(parts) >= 5 accepts any depth and any .html name, and the plan segment is unchecked - so the claim rule here and the composition reader there can disagree when the shape is refined.

non-blocking: the done_when names the gate as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but the recorded gate and both arms ran in place inside the worker worktree - logs/head-test-file.log names that tree, no sbatch invocation appears in the run's session logs, and the delivered head gate therefore measures the same file under a condition the done_when did not state.
